title: Semantic (continent) control for the quiet tail: pre-registration
status: DRAFT until scripts/freeze_prereg.py --prereg prereg/continent_control_prereg.json has written continent_control_prereg.lock.json and both files are committed. Edit only before freezing.
relation_to_thesis: Added after the two-tail and word-level results were known, to address the thesis's stated main limitation (the pre-registered quiet-tail control is surface length, not semantic). Changes nothing frozen in two_tail_prereg.json or word_specificity_prereg.json. Frozen before any continent-control output was produced.
claim_tested: Truth is recovered better from the low-variance tail than from the high-variance head, MORE than a semantic label with no truth content is.
gemma_policy: Every test reported with and without gemma-2-2b; a conclusion is robust only if it holds both ways.

data.primary: truth_cities, first 512 pairs of data/statements/truth_cities.jsonl (the pairs used in the thesis)
data.continent_map: data/country_continent.json, UN M49 regions. Oceania (Australia, one statement) folded into Asia so no class has a single member. Classes: Africa, Americas, Asia, Europe.

labels.named_continent: PRIMARY CONTROL. Continent of the country named in each statement, parsed from the text (' is in X.' / ' is not in X.'). Varies within a pair whenever the false country is on another continent (312 of 512 pairs). Predicts truth at 0.514 on these pairs (Cramer's V 0.049).
labels.city_continent: SECONDARY CONTROL. Continent of the city's correct country (the pair's 'topic' field); identical for both members of a pair, so independent of truth by construction.
labels.length_bucket: REFERENCE. The thesis's pre-registered control, re-run on the same activations as a reproduction check.

method: Identical to the thesis quiet tail: test_concept_subspace.run_cell with the published language-subset basis, last-token pooling, k = 0.005 d, 10 windows, multinomial logistic regression (L-BFGS, C = 1, standardised, five pair-grouped folds), retention against the majority rate, Delta = tilt(concept) - tilt(control) with the quiet-tail sign, paired bootstrap over items with 10,000 resamples. Cached activations from the thesis runs are reused.

primary.cell: truth_cities, mid layer (hidden state floor(L/2)), control named_continent
primary.test: one-sample t-test of per-model Delta against 0 across models, two-sided, alpha 0.05; Wilcoxon signed-rank reported alongside
primary.equivalence: TOST with bounds +/-0.10 retention units (the thesis quiet-tail bound)

usable_cell_rule: Same as the thesis: concept full-dimensional headroom >= 0.10 and the shuffled-label floor check passes; additionally the control's headroom must exceed 0.02 (retention guard) and Delta must be computable. pair_id_random full-dimensional accuracy is reported for every cell as the leakage detector.

decision_rule.specific: 95% CI of the mean Delta above 0 in both the all-model and without-gemma versions

secondary_reported_not_primary: length_bucket on the same activations, as a check against the thesis numbers
multiplicity: One primary test. Secondary rows are reported in full and not used for the conclusion.
